export.title: Export data
export.description: Export any record type — configuration, master data, or custom records — as CSV, Excel, or JSON.
export.exported: Exported {filename} with {count, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}.
export.needColumns: Select at least one column to export.
export.noColumns: This record type has no exportable columns.
export.loadFailed: Could not load exportable record types.
export.columnsLoadFailed: Could not load columns for this record type.
export.failed: The export could not be completed.

import.title: Import data
import.description: Bring records into any record type with column mapping and a dry-run preview before anything is written.
import.parseFailed: Could not read the import file.
import.noColumns: The file has no column headers. Add a header row and try again.
import.loadFailed: Could not load importable record types.
import.mapHint: Match each column in your file to a field. Unmapped columns are ignored.
import.truncatedWarning: Only the first {n} rows were read — the rest of the file was left out. Split the file and import the remainder separately.
import.commit: Import {n, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
import.commitFailed: The import could not be completed.
import.commitPersistenceFailed: This browser could not save the import retry key, so no import was sent. Enable session storage or use a browser that allows it, then try again.
import.commitConflict: This import conflicts with an earlier attempt. Check Import History first. If you changed the file or mapping, preview and submit the updated import; reloading with unchanged inputs safely retries the earlier request.
import.postPost: Create and post to the ledger

sample.title: Explore a complete sample company
sample.description: Open a realistic, industry-specific company with customers, vendors, transactions, reports, projects, and closed periods already in place.
sample.error: The sample company could not be prepared
sample.firstGeneration: The first copy may take a few minutes while its verified template is generated
sample.safety: Sample data is copied into a separate, clearly marked workspace. It never enters your live books, and email, payment, API, and integration side effects remain disabled.
sample.createFailed: Sample company could not be created. Nothing was created; you can retry.
sample.createFailedTemplate: Sample company could not be created: preparing the verified template failed. Nothing was created; you can retry.
sample.createFailedClone: Sample company could not be created: copying the template's posted history failed. Nothing was created; you can retry.
sample.createFailedFinalize: Sample company could not be created: finalizing the new company failed. The company was created but its setup did not finish; retry resumes it from where it stopped.
sample.createFailedNumbering: Sample company could not be created: reconciling document numbering failed. The company was created but its document numbering was not finished; retry resumes numbering.

import.sourceTitle: Select records and upload a file
import.sourceHint: Choose the record type to import. Map its columns and preview the changes before importing.
import.fileHint: CSV, Excel (.xlsx), or JSON. Include column headers for CSV and Excel files.
import.pasteHint: Paste CSV with a header row, or a JSON array of records. Choose the matching format above.
import.reviewHint: Review the counts and any errors before importing. No records have been imported yet.

commitBlocked.errors: {n, plural, one {# row has an error} other {# rows have errors}}. Fix them in the file and preview again; nothing is imported until every row passes.
commitBlocked.stale: The file, mapping or options changed after this preview. Preview again before importing.
commitBlocked.nothing: No rows would be created or updated, so there is nothing to import.
commitBlocked.notReady: The preview is still being prepared. Import becomes available when it finishes.

history.title: Import history
history.description: Every import run, with record counts and any errors.

transfer.title: Transfer status
transfer.reconnecting: Connection interrupted. Reconnecting; the server job continues.
transfer.batchPolicy: Import batches commit independently. Cancellation or a refusal preserves earlier committed batches and their audit history. Posted transactions require their normal controlled reversal.
transfer.resumeUpload: To resume an interrupted upload, select the same original file and continue.
